# Brian on Things

> Brian Obot is a software engineer and Python & Rust developer writing about backend systems, low-level internals, and the physics and maths beneath them.

This is the personal blog of Brian Obot, a software engineer and Python & Rust developer. It has in-depth, practical articles on Python (FastAPI, Django, Pydantic, performance), Rust (ownership, lifetimes, modules, bytes), low-level systems and developer tooling, written from hands-on experience.

## About

- [About Brian Obot: Software Engineer, Python & Rust Developer](https://brianobot.tech/about/): I'm Brian Obot, a software engineer and freelance Python & Rust developer building backend systems, contributing to open source and writing about software.
- [Hire a Freelance Python & Rust Developer – Brian Obot](https://brianobot.tech/hire/): Freelance Python and Rust developer for backend APIs, FastAPI and Django services, Rust web services and performance work. Open to contracts and open source.
- [Projects](https://brianobot.tech/projects/): Things I've built, and things I've built in order to learn

## Posts

- [Introduction to Bytes in Rust. Part 1](https://brianobot.tech/blog/working-with-bytes-in-rust/): A beginner-friendly tour of bits, bytes and hexadecimal, and how Rust represents them.

- [Learning Technical Skills in the Age of SI](https://brianobot.tech/blog/learning-technical-skills-in-the-age-of-si/): What is the motivation and point of even trying when you're constantly faced with the reality that a computer can do it better and faster, why should I bother learning the basics? - Brian (Some cool guy)

- [Stop Writing Manual Validation: Master Pydantic](https://brianobot.tech/blog/stop-writing-manual-validation-master-pydantic/): Go beyond basic type hints and build robust, production-ready Python with less code using Pydantic's validation.

- [Setting Up Rust Analyzer to work for Non-Cargo-Based Rust Projects](https://brianobot.tech/blog/setting-up-rust-analyzer-for-non-cargo-rust-projects/): Getting autocomplete, type hints, and navigation in single-file Rust programs—without Cargo.

- [6 Python Tips That Quietly Level Up Your Code](https://brianobot.tech/blog/some-python-tips-that-quietly-level-up-your-code/): A few understated tricks that separate working code from elegant code.
